title: Security Operation Launched in Jammu and Kashmir's Shopian After Suspicious Activity
summary: A security operation was launched in Jammu and Kashmir's Shopian after suspicious activity was reported. The operation began following a tip-off about the presence of militants in the Chanapora area. The Indian Army and police have been conducting a joint search operation in the area, which has resulted in the arrest of two suspected militants. The situation remains tense, with reports of firing exchanged between security forces and militants.
summary_points: A security operation was launched in Jammu and Kashmir's Shopian following suspicious activity.
